message.content: {"note_claim": "The $5 billion US arms package to Saudi Arabia is a proposed congressional notification for precision-guided JDAM munitions, not finalized delivery of indiscriminate bombs.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "By far the largest approved sale would be for Riyadh to buy just over 10,000 kits of the extended range Joint Direct Attack Munition (JDAM) and associated equipment in a deal valued at $5 billion.", "reason": "The page confirms the $5B deal is for JDAM kits (precision-guided munitions), describes it as a congressional notification that 'is not final,' and notes the dumb bombs 'when equipped with a JDAM can be used as a precision weapon.'"}

parsed.note_claim: The $5 billion US arms package to Saudi Arabia is a proposed congressional notification for precision-guided JDAM munitions, not finalized delivery of indiscriminate bombs.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: By far the largest approved sale would be for Riyadh to buy just over 10,000 kits of the extended range Joint Direct Attack Munition (JDAM) and associated equipment in a deal valued at $5 billion.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the $5B deal is for JDAM kits (precision-guided munitions), describes it as a congressional notification that 'is not final,' and notes the dumb bombs 'when equipped with a JDAM can be used as a precision weapon.'
